description_en: Call the DescribeZoneInfo operation to retrieve the details of a specified built-in authoritative zone. The details include the list of VPCs that are bound to the zone
description_zh: 调用DescribeZoneInfo获取指定内置权威域名（Zone）的详细信息，包括当前Zone绑定的VPC列表信息等
name: DescribeZoneInfo

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the zone
parameters.name: zone_id

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the VPC is located

RegionName.description_en: The name of the region where the VPC is located
RegionName.description_zh: 专有网络（vpc）所属地域名称

VpcId.description_en: The unique ID of the VPC
VpcId.description_zh: Vpc ID，专有网络唯一标识

VpcType.description_en:
The type of the VPC. Valid values:

STANDARD: Standard VPC.

EDS: Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) workspace VPC
VpcType.description_zh:
专有网络（vpc）类型。说明：

STANDARD：标准VPC。

EDS：无影工作区VPC

VpcUserId.description_en: The ID of the user to which the VPC belongs. If this parameter is null, the VPC belongs to the current user
VpcUserId.description_zh: 专有网络（vpc）归属的用户Id；若为null则归属当前用户

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the zone was created

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the zone was created

DnsGroup.description_en:
The DNS group. Valid values:

NORMAL_ZONE: Regular group

FAST_ZONE: Fast group
DnsGroup.description_zh:
内置权威位置区。说明：

NORMAL_ZONE：普通区
FAST_ZONE：快速区

DnsGroupChanging.description_en:
The status of switching the DNS group for the zone. You can switch a zone between the regular and fast groups. Valid values:

true: The DNS group is being switched.

false: The DNS group is not being switched
DnsGroupChanging.description_zh:
Zone切换位置区状态（普通区和快速区切换）。说明：

true：切换中
false：未切换

IsPtr.description_en:
Indicates whether the zone is a reverse lookup zone. Valid values:

true: The zone is a reverse lookup zone.

false: The zone is not a reverse lookup zone
IsPtr.description_zh:
是否反解zone。说明：
true：是反解zone
false：非反解zone

ProxyPattern.description_en:
Indicates whether the recursive proxy for subdomains is enabled.

ZONE: Disabled. If a non-existent subdomain is resolved, an NXDOMAIN response is returned to indicate that the subdomain does not exist.

RECORD: Enabled. If a non-existent subdomain is resolved, the system queries the forwarding and recursion modules in sequence and uses the final result to respond to the DNS query
ProxyPattern.description_zh:
是否开启子域名递归代理。说明：

ZONE: 关闭（当解析本域名下不存在的子域名时，直接返回NXDOMAIN，表示子域名不存在）

RECORD: 开启（当解析本域名下不存在的子域名时，会依次查询“转发”和“递归”模块，并以最终查询到的解析结果来应答解析请求）

RecordCount.description_en: The total number of DNS records in the zone
RecordCount.description_zh: 当前Zone设置的解析记录总数

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the zone belongs

SlaveDns.description_en:
Indicates whether secondary DNS is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled

false: Disabled
SlaveDns.description_zh:
是否开启辅助DNS。取值：

true：已开启
false：未开启

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the zone was last updated

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the zone was last updated

ZoneId.description_en: The unique ID of the zone

ZoneType.description_en:
The type of the zone. Valid values:

AUTH_ZONE: Authoritative zone.

CLOUD_PRODUCT_ZONE: Authoritative zone for a cloud product
ZoneType.description_zh:
Zone类型。说明：
AUTH_ZONE：权威Zone；
CLOUD_PRODUCT_ZONE：云产品权威Zone
